test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the value of a in the following equation. (Given a frac{(187 div 17 times {a}-3 times 3)}{(8²-9 times 7+{a}²)}=1~
solution:
**Given:**

frac{(187 div 17 times {a}-3 times 3)}{(8²-9 times 7+{a}²)}=1~

**Calculation:**

⇒ 11 × a – 9 = 8² – 63 + a²

⇒ 11a – 9 = a² + 64 – 63
